name: jev-compact
description: Jev-guided Codex compaction with exact post-compaction dedupe and observe mode.

interface.shortDescription: Restore only useful evidence missing after Codex compaction.
interface.longDescription: Uses Jev to select useful history before Codex compaction and restore exact missing evidence. Requires an OpenRouter or TypeSafe API key; configure it after installation. Observe mode measures the pipeline without changing Codex context.
defaultPrompt: Show what Jev retained from the last compaction.
